summary: 58-year-old man drowned attempting to swim across Marshall Lake near S. 66th St/Coal Creek Dr in unincorporated Boulder County; went under ~4:55 p.m. and was not seen for 6-7 minutes; boaters pulled him out while BCSO, fire agencies, and rescue-dog teams were en route; CPR and AED attempted on scene and at Avista Hospital — pronounced dead
responding_agency: BCSO, Rocky Mountain Fire, Louisville Fire, Boulder Emergency Squad, Longmont Emergency Unit, Front Range Rescue Dogs
